title: It's A Wonderful Life 2026
seo_title: It's A Wonderful Life 2026 at Gillioz Theatre
description: This is a free screening of the film It's A Wonderful Life at the Gillioz Theatre, with free hot chocolate while supplies last and free photo ops with Mr. & Mrs. Claus. It suits families and film fans; seating is general admission, and reservations are required by phone at 417-863-9491 or in person at the Gillioz Box Office, limit 4 tickets per order. It takes place Sunday, December 13, 2026, with doors at 1:00 PM and the movie at 2:00 PM, at 325 Park Central E. in Springfield, MO.
